# Patched go-imap v1.2.1 (SR3-mail-k18)

Upstream github.com/emersion/go-imap v1.2.1 (go.sum h1:+s9ZjMEjOB8NzZMVTM3cCenz2JrQIGGo5j1df19WjTA=), the packages broker imports, without tests; LICENSE is upstream's. broker/go.mod replaces the module with this directory. Edits are marked `agentos:`. In client/client.go, `reader` recovers a panic, closes the connection and ends (the in-flight command then fails with errClosed); SR3-mail-k18c (#1255) keeps a recovered panic from leaving `c.locker` held: `State`, `Mailbox`, `SetState` and `gotStatusCaps` unlock by `defer`, and `handleUnilateral`'s EXISTS and RECENT read the selected mailbox once and update that one, so a refused SELECT that clears `c.mailbox` meanwhile no longer makes them dereference nil under the lock. SR3-mail-k18b (#1254) added: `reader` also closes the connection when it stops on a read error; in read.go `ReadList` refuses lists nested deeper than 100 with `ErrListTooDeep`, which is not a parse error, so the reader ends instead of overflowing its stack, `ReadLiteral` reads a literal as its bytes arrive instead of allocating its declared size first (one of `smallLiteral`, 4 KiB, or less is allocated at its exact size), `ReadFields` refuses a response's field past `maxRespFields` (1<<20) with `ErrTooManyFields`, also not a parse error, counted in `Reader.fields` and reset by `ReadLine` and, in response.go, `ReadResp`, and `ReadAtom` builds the atom with a strings.Builder instead of quadratic string concatenation. The bytes a reply may cost in total are bounded by imapsmtp's per-session budget, not here. date.go differs only by gofmt's comment reflow (CI's Format step). No response handler is edited. See broker/mail/ASSUMPTIONS.md for when to drop this.
